recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current core source edit is needed unless a future work group decision asks to revise broader Questionnaire explanatory comments.
issue_request: FHIR-9110 is a Published/Persuasive technical correction requesting that the Questionnaire.item.required and Questionnaire.item.repeats descriptions say item rather than group.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites svn revision 7897, which corresponds to git commit 420cf96a58a5b7fd788fce97611ba4fe5fcf5379. That commit changed both Questionnaire spreadsheet short labels from group wording to item wording.
additional_context: Questionnaire is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. Later source refactors carried the corrected labels into source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-Questionnaire.xml. The obsolete phrases were not found in active Questionnaire source; remaining matches are archival tools/history/release2 snapshots. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current build-scope source already satisfies the issue. Nearby group wording in comments describes group-type items and is outside the obsolete short-label wording requested by FHIR-9110.
